reason: Both letters make a strong case by showing she is already taking a Dentrix course and has a solid track record in billing, though I am mixed on the details in Document B: learning she kept her skills sharp using QuickBooks for the past four years eases my hesitation about the seven-year gap, while reading that she left her last clinic with only two weeks' notice hits a nerve right now.
